item.title: Yoru Meguru, Bokura no Maigo Kyoushitsu
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: SAMOYED SMILE
  • 発売日: 2017-11-24
  • スコア: 7.37/10 (263 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 夜巡る、ボクらの迷子教室
  • 英語名: Yoru Meguru, Bokura no Maigo Kyoushitsu

别名

  • Yoruboku

あらすじ

Haruki fulfilled his wish of becoming a teacher, but he soon became disillusioned after his ideals were shattered after witnessing first-hand the corruption at his first post at a private school. Ever since then, he has half-assed his job, having lost his ambition.

One day, his father Hidetsugu, who he broke off relations with, had a request for him from his hospital bed. He was the principal of the Fujiwara night school and he wanted Haruki to become a teacher for the remaining students and help them graduate before the school closes next year. In return, he would receive his father’s vast inheritance. While this alone should be enough to convince him to accept, Haruki thought that it would be a great opportunity to recover what he had lost.

item.title: Samidare Growing Up!
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: SAMOYED SMILE
  • 発売日: 2015-11-27
  • スコア: 7.01/10 (75 人評価)
  • 日本語名: さみだれグローインアップ！
  • 英語名: Samidare Growing Up!

别名

  • さみグロ

あらすじ

This is the debut title for SAMOYED SMILE, which is affiliated with softhouse-seal.

Hinata was like everyone at Yadachigawa Academy who recognized Kiriha as the perfect student who is both smart and beautiful. However, his childhood friend Makoto said that her appearance is merely a façade. He would later find out about her hidden true side by chance. Accepted into his group of friends, Kiriha found out how good it felt to be able to be herself without having to put on a fake exterior. Along with his classmate and childhood friend Haneru and his younger sister Hiyori, who looks up to her, they enjoy their days together while causing mischief. However, the student council was not happy with their carefree group, especially the vice-president Yaeka, who was jealous of Kiriha and vowed to expose her true side.
